errors.text_span: Първата кръгова диаграма в долната част на изображението визуално представя процентното разпределение на активите в "Портфейл 5", показвайки осем сектора: 7ТН със 41%, EUR_USD с 32%, Schroder с 10%, Gold със 7%, AUD_USD с 4%, ETH_USD със 4%, и "Other" със 6% без конкретна етикет.
errors.evidence: The description states that the first pie chart has eight sectors and lists seven, including 'ETH_USD с 4%'. In reality, the first pie chart has only six sectors (7TH, EUR_USD, Schroder, Gold, AUD_USD, Other), and ETH_USD is not one of them; it is part of the second pie chart.
The label in the second pie chart is 'SPET', not '5PET'. The model likely copied an OCR error.
The description fails to mention the key structural relationship between the two pie charts: that the second pie chart is an expanded breakdown of the 'Other' category from the first pie chart.
The table header is 'Възвръщаемост' with 'OCT' written underneath. Translating 'OCT' to 'октомври' (October) is an interpretation, which the prompt asks to avoid.

errors.text_span: съставните части са подредени в низходящ ред по размер
errors.evidence: The statement that the slices are ordered in descending order by size is incorrect. The order of percentages is 41%, 32%, 10%, 7%, 4%, 6%. The 'Other' slice at 6% breaks the strict descending order after 'AUD_USD' at 4%.
